verdicts.reason: The two candidates are almost identical and both fail in the same ways. The hero photo is shrunk to a small strip floating in white space, with a large dead gap between it and the headline. The headline has lost its yellow underline bars and no longer overlaps the image. The big circle is cut off at the top, the circle motif is shrunk to a tiny dot cluster, and the yellow bars are scattered at the bottom with no link to the text. B's headline leading is slightly tighter, closer to the original, but its dot cluster looks clipped, so neither one is better overall.
